description: This file defines the TransactionCommitterAttribute class, a custom attribute used for marking parameters related to transaction committers within the Orleans.Transactions.Abstractions namespace. It includes properties for service and storage names and implements relevant interfaces.

classes.name: TransactionCommitterAttribute
classes.description: A custom attribute class used to annotate parameters with transaction committer metadata, including service and storage names.

methods.name: TransactionCommitterAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ServiceName and optional StorageName properties.
